# T-2: Preserve fail-closed validation

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Keep impl-gate validation strict for stale, malformed, failed, missing-log, digest-mismatched, and authority-mismatched upgrade evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R5 failure modes are rejected instead of treated as current evidence.
- Validation still succeeds without an artifact only when current upgrade-required paths are empty.

## Implementation Notes
Extend existing artifact validation and recovery checks without weakening validateUpgradeEvidenceForGate behavior.

## Test Strategy
Add spec-local tests for stale checkedPaths, malformed result, failed result, missing raw log, raw-log digest mismatch, and authority mismatch; update tests/unit/flow/upgrade-required-changed-paths.test.js when changed-path detection behavior changes.
